conf.description: GitLab (self-managed) api / production.log (syslog-raw): multi-line Started/Processing/Parameters/Completed Rails block assumed pre-reassembled by the Source's event breaker, then regex-extracted per field, computed fields (status_code, duration, capped params, UTC _time) derived before the clean-name batch rename; degraded feed with no user/correlation_id per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: gitlab-self-managed / api / syslog-raw (production.log). Hand-built: no Elastic integration parses the Rails text form, no vendor pack covers it. api's json format (api_json.log) already has a thin pass-through pipeline elsewhere in this dir - this file covers only syslog-raw, per recommendations.direct.cribl: prefer production_json.log wherever available, treat this as a fallback with no user identity, no correlation_id, local-zone timestamp. Multi-line reassembly of the Started..Completed block is a Source-level Event Breaker concern (out of scope for a Pipeline-only build); this pipeline assumes that already happened and regex-extracts the key lines from one multi-line _raw. Parameters is a Ruby hash literal, not JSON, so it's captured as capped raw text. _raw dropped after extraction - every field of interest is captured and Parameters is caller-influenced.

functions.description: record approach, scope boundary on multi-line reassembly, and why this file is separate from the existing api/json pass-through
extract the Started line: HTTP method, path, client address, local-zone request start time
extract the Processing line: Rails controller, action, response format
extract the filtered Parameters hash literal as raw text (caller-influenced, capped downstream)
extract the Completed line: HTTP status, total/view/ActiveRecord durations in milliseconds

compute derived/typed fields from the original regex capture names before the clean-name rename: UTC _time from the local-zone offset, numeric status code, event.duration in nanoseconds, length-capped and control-stripped params, dataset tag
batch every clean-path status:mapped/unmapped-with-custom-target field that needed no further transform
drop now-fully-consumed regex capture temporaries and _raw (every field of interest already extracted; _raw would otherwise carry an uncapped copy of the Parameters text past the cap applied above)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
